tools.blocked_reason:
BLOCKED, and the reason is a platform gap the model found for me. Called 0/5 with 0 errors across 5 clean runs: a real soft-deleted entity was seeded and the model was asked to restore it BY NAME. It searched the glossary, the chapter text and project memory, found nothing — because a deleted row is invisible to all three — and said so: 'I couldn't find "Mira Solene" ... Since I can't see her in the trash (the recycle bin) without an ID, I'll need you to provide her element ID.' That is the correct answer.
🔴 THE TOOL IS UNREACHABLE BY DESIGN, not by accident: NOTHING in the catalogue lists a soft-deleted glossary entity. Measured across the whole surface — 10 restore tools ship, only 4 of the things they restore can be listed, and this is one of the 6 that cannot (D-RESTORE-WITH-NO-WAY-TO-SEE-WHAT-IS-RESTORABLE). The tool ITSELF is honest: restoring an id that is not deleted returns {restored: false} rather than claiming success — the correct counter-example to the arc_template archive defect.
